description: Default capability for ymux. Grants core IPC + event APIs. Closing the window hides it to the tray and a real quit exits from Rust (src-tauri/src/tray.rs), so the frontend needs no window destroy/close permission. The tray is built and relabelled in Rust only, so every core:tray command that core:default pulls in (with the tray-icon feature) is denied — a deny wins over an allow in Tauri's ACL.
